scope: Exact Windows 11 installed runtime, signed physical Android tablet and real Playwright CLI viewer. Verified shared video, control handoff, Android keyboard, program audio and microphone routing.

shared_example.management_control_transfer: Web to Android and back to Web

program_audio.source: Bounded 997 Hz signal from the Example process, with only the project WASAPI output selected
program_audio.separate_bounded_runs_with_both_clients: Video shared a single upstream. Program audio was measured on each client in separate bounded playback runs.

microphone.source: Actual physical tablet microphone, short ambient sample measured in memory

open_items: Actual isolated Windows 11 clean installation, rollback operation and physical LAN migration remain unverified.
Win11 foreground ownership prevented subsequent target Web pointer and revocation tests after the desktop locked. The earlier tablet key test explicitly verified the Example foreground owner.

Exact-payload CI run 45809998961 logged positive native Web key and pointer delivery. Its revocation check was inconclusive because the expected fresh input frames were absent. It remains a failed run.

The first Web audio observation occurred before normal playback activation. The zero-energy observation is not counted as success. After a viewer click, the active microphone had measurable decoded audio and silence was restored when capture stopped.

A local audio route automation waiter expected PUT although the supported API uses PATCH. The later authoritative session state confirmed the real UI update. The microphone measurements followed that confirmation.

Stale reconnect and host-lock attempts were kept out of successful observations. The bounded successful audio tests used ADB only on the owned application, without unlocking the host or retaining audio samples.
